transcript.text: Hi everyone, I've received the Customer Programs team's proposal for a six-week rotation where Lina would serve as acting coordinator for their weekly implementation work. The role would involve eight hours per week, attending the team's Tuesday standup, and handling routine escalations independently. Before I make a final decision on whether this goes ahead and what conditions to attach, I'd like to follow our normal review process and have a check-in with Lina and a current collaborator. I'm open to hearing any thoughts or concerns people have at this stage as well.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share something important: I have an approved caregiving arrangement that limits my rotation work to exactly 4 hours per week and makes Tuesday mornings unavailable. I didn't raise it with Maya earlier because I assumed the nomination packet already reflected my standard schedule, but I realize now that may not have been the case.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I should share what I've observed: Lina has not yet handled a cross-team escalation without help. I already agreed to serve as her escalation mentor for exactly 6 weeks if the rotation is approved, but I haven't documented either point in the nomination packet. Given Lina's update about her 4-hour-per-week limit and Tuesday morning unavailability, I think it's important to factor this in as Maya considers conditions.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Rotation hours set to 4 hours per week to respect Lina's approved caregiving arrangement.
Lina is excused from the Tuesday morning standup; she will coordinate with the team for an alternative touchpoint time.
Jordan will serve as Lina's escalation mentor for the full 6-week rotation duration.
Lina will not handle escalations independently; escalations will be routed with Jordan's mentorship support.
